sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Gold Paperclip & Heart Chain Bracelet Combo
sourceNotes.rawContent: Double the charm with this chic gold-toned bracelet duo. Pairing a bold paperclip link with a delicate heart chain, this high-fashion set is perfect for effortless layering. To maintain its radiant golden luster, keep these pieces dry and store safely in a dry place after every wear.
